response.original_title: 【Expert™-Support】 How to communicate on Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: You can communicate on a Carnival cruise using the Carnival HUB App onboard messaging feature for a flat fee of $5 per person for the entire voyage. Contact or Call +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) +44-289-708-0062 (UK)  Carnival HUB App Chat Setup: Download the app before boarding. Put your phone in airplane mode and connect to the ship's free Wi-Fi network once onboard. Activation: Log in using your Sail & Sign folio/booking details and pay the small flat activation fee, which is billed to your onboard account.  Alternative Communication Methods Internet Packages: Purchase a Carnival Wi-Fi plan (Social, Value, or Premium) to use standard apps like WhatsApp, iMessage, or Facebook Messenger. Cabin Phones: Use your stateroom telephone to call other staterooms or ship services for free. Old-School Methods: Stick post-it notes on mirrors or bring magnetic whiteboards to attach to your stateroom door for leaving notes.
